label: Workshop helper
summary: A wrench, a screwdriver and a brush in stands on the bench. “When I put my hand out, give me the wrench” is a standing rule: hold your open hand out and the robot hands it over.
examples: When I put my hand out, give me the wrench
When I'm done with the brush, put it back

setup.say: Workshop ready. I'm watching for your open hand: hold it out and I'll give you the wrench.

rules.text: when I put my hand out, give me the wrench

physics: Handing over uses the robot's grasp (contact grasp with P0 physics, a kinematic grasp otherwise); the person's hand is the camera pose.
